lieu: small bedroom at night in Abobo, Abidjan, a simple bed with a thin mattress, an empty wooden wardrobe with its door open, moonlight through the window

persos.nom: the skinny burglar with the flashlight
persos.desc: skinny burglar in his 30s, black balaclava rolled up on his forehead, black long-sleeve shirt, holding a small flashlight
persos.pose: standing by the bed pointing the flashlight at the sleeping man, trying to look threatening

persos.nom: the sleepy man in the lilac pyjama shirt
persos.desc: sleepy man in his 50s, bald with a grey fringe, wrinkled lilac pyjama shirt
persos.pose: sitting up in bed, rubbing his eyes, calm

dialogue: Vieux père, donne-moi tout ton argent !
Attends, on va chercher ensemble. Si tu trouves, on partage dêh.
jeu: The burglar whispers his threat. The old man answers calmly while still sitting on the bed, facing the burglar, his face clearly visible. Only after his line, he slowly gets up and opens the empty wardrobe; the burglar keeps holding his small flashlight the whole time.
chute: Both men stare into the empty wardrobe side by side. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the burglar's confused face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room of a modest apartment in Koumassi, Abidjan, worn sofa, a baby playmat on the floor, afternoon light

persos.desc: young mother in her 20s, teal-and-gold ankara jumpsuit, short twists
persos.pose: kneeling on the floor, clapping with joy

persos.nom: the tired father on the sofa
persos.desc: tired father in his 30s, faded black tracksuit, holding an empty wallet
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa, looking at his empty wallet

persos.nom: the baby in the yellow romper
persos.desc: baby around 1 year old in a tiny yellow romper
persos.pose: standing on the playmat, taking a first wobbly step

dialogue: Chéri, regarde ! Bébé a commencé à marcher dêh !
Il a vu qu'on n'a pas l'argent du transport.
jeu: The mother claps with joy as the baby takes wobbly steps. The father looks at his empty wallet and answers flatly.
chute: The baby keeps walking slowly and seriously toward the door. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the mother's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: front yard of a modest family house in Abobo, Abidjan, the metal gate is open and a shiny black SUV is parked just outside, late afternoon

persos.nom: the little brother with the afro
persos.desc: boy around 12, oversized red-and-white basketball jersey, afro with a pick comb in it
persos.pose: standing in the middle of the yard, pointing at the SUV with a disgusted face

persos.nom: the sister in the denim dress
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, light-blue denim dress, short bleached curly hair, handbag on her shoulder
persos.pose: standing still next to the open gate on the left, ready to leave, looking at her phone

persos.nom: the broke father fixing a radio
persos.desc: father in his 50s, worn grey undershirt with holes, old flip-flops, sitting on a low stool in the right foreground fixing an old radio with a screwdriver, his face clearly visible
persos.pose: sitting in the right foreground, busy with his radio

dialogue: Grande sœur, ton copain-là est trop laid dêh !
Ahh… Donc le vrai laid ici, c'est papa.
jeu: All three characters stay in their places for the whole video; nobody walks away. The boy complains with a disgusted face. The sister answers without moving, only turning her head toward him. The boy thinks for a second, then slowly turns his head toward their father in the right foreground.
chute: The father stops fixing the radio, slowly raises his head and stares at the boy, deeply offended, the screwdriver frozen in his hand. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: courtyard of a family house in Yopougon, Abidjan, plastic chairs, a cooking pot on a table, a thin brown dog lying near the gate

persos.nom: the mother-in-law in the ruby lace
persos.desc: elegant mother-in-law in her 60s, ruby-red lace kaba dress with a matching headwrap
persos.pose: looking her son-in-law up and down with worry

persos.desc: very skinny son-in-law in his 30s with sunken cheeks, oversized brown checkered blazer
persos.pose: sitting on a plastic chair, sad

dialogue: Mon fils, tu as maigri ! Ma fille te nourrit pas ?
Si, Maman. Mais sa cuisine-là, même le chien a démissionné.
jeu: The mother-in-law asks with worry. The son-in-law answers sadly and points discreetly toward the gate.
chute: The thin dog slowly gets up and walks out through the open gate without looking back. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the mother-in-law's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: small dining table in a modest house in Abobo, Abidjan, two plates with only white rice, a pot, evening

persos.nom: the boy in the flag t-shirt
persos.desc: boy around 9, orange-white-green flag t-shirt, holding a spoon
persos.pose: looking at his plate of plain rice, disappointed

persos.nom: the father in the rust polo
persos.desc: slim father in his 40s, rust-red polo shirt, small goatee

dialogue: Papa, pourquoi on mange jamais viande ?
Mon fils, les végétariens vivent longtemps.
Mais on mange même pas légumes !
Voilà ! Nous on va vivre encore plus longtemps.
jeu: The boy complains. The father answers like a wise man. The boy protests, pointing at his plain rice. The father raises his spoon proudly.
chute: The father keeps eating his plain rice proudly. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the boy's devastated face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room in Marcory, Abidjan, a mirror on the wall, a makeup bag open on a side table, morning

persos.desc: aunt in her 40s, very heavy colorful makeup, giant false eyelashes, magenta lipstick, large floral orange dress
persos.pose: posing in front of the mirror, very proud

persos.desc: little girl around 6, missing front tooth, pink tutu skirt and white t-shirt
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa, looking at the aunt very seriously

dialogue: Ma chérie, Tantie est jolie comme ça, hein ? Dis-moi gbê !
Oui Tantie. Ce matin-là tu étais laide, mais maintenant ça va dêh.
jeu: The aunt poses proudly and asks. The little girl answers with total honesty and a sweet smile.
chute: The aunt freezes with her lipstick in the air. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the aunt's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: public primary school classroom in Yopougon, Abidjan, wooden desks, chalkboard, sunny morning

persos.nom: the teacher with the green glasses
persos.desc: female teacher in her 30s, white blouse, navy pencil skirt, green-framed glasses, holding chalk
boy around 8, round face, tiny afro, blue-and-yellow school uniform
persos.pose: standing at his desk, very proud

dialogue: Mon petit, ton papa-là fait quel travail ?
Non, au maquis dêh. Il influence les gens à payer sa bière.
jeu: The teacher asks kindly. The boy answers proudly, chest out. The teacher is impressed, then her smile fades at the last answer.
chute: The teacher slowly puts her chalk down. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the teacher's speechless face looking into the camera.
